name: Hybrid Implicit Isosurface Ray Tracing
definition: A rendering technique that extracts a list of active vertex-centered cubic primitives (octants or dual cells) from cell-centered TB-AMR data, builds a BVH over them, and performs implicit ray-isosurface intersection within each primitive, avoiding the memory cost of explicit triangle extraction.
summary: Hybrid Implicit Isosurface Ray Tracing extracts active voxel primitives to build a BVH, then performs implicit ray intersections within them to produce high-quality, crack-free isosurfaces without explicit triangle extraction.
